_notes: Demo field notes for the /reports 'Try a demo' CTA. Fictional people only — never put a real inmate, staff member, or ADC number in this file. Staff names must resolve against staff_roster.json so the demo shows clean roster resolution rather than spurious gaps.

scenarios.label: Inmate on inmate fight
scenarios.teaches: Complete run — every required slot present. Shows per-inmate disposition lines and the 'fights end in Restrictive Housing' convention.
scenarios.notes:
Rhodes ADC#900512 & Vance ADC#900534 fighting 8 Barracks
~2:15pm
Vance cut over left eye, bleeding
Rhodes on top throwing punches when I got there
Sgt Whitfield pulled Rhodes off, cuffed him
Cpl Alvarez cuffed Vance
Both escorted to Restrictive Housing by Cpl Alvarez & Cpl Nguyen
Vance seen by Infirmary — 3 sutures over eye
Rhodes refused medical
Photos taken of Vance eye and blood on floor
Capt Lindholm notified 2:20pm
Both said the other started it
Witness statements collected from 2 inmates

scenarios.label: Introduction of contraband
scenarios.teaches: Complete run against the heaviest conditional branch — satisfies all four contraband rules (drugs -> field test, money -> receipt number, chain of custody, F401).
scenarios.notes:
Routine shakedown 4 Barracks ~9:30am
Inmate Prewitt ADC#900608 nervous, kept eyeing his bunk
Found baggie green leafy substance in mattress seam — approx 2 grams
Also homemade tattoo gun (CD player motor, needle, pen tube)
Prewitt said "that ain't mine, somebody put it there"
Field test positive for THC
Sgt Whitfield photographed and bagged items
Chain of custody to Cpl Nguyen
F401 Confiscation Form completed
$23 found in bunk — Business Office money receipt #4421
Cuffed by Cpl Alvarez
Escorted to Restrictive Housing by Cpl Alvarez & Cpl Castillo
Prewitt refused drug test
Capt Lindholm authorized contraband seizure 9:45am

scenarios.label: Use of force (chemical agent)
scenarios.teaches: GAP SCENARIO — establishes a chemical-agent use of force but never gives the canister MFG year, lot number or PMF/serial. Those are blocking, and the model cannot guess them, so the Missing Information panel has to fire. Do not 'fix' this by adding the numbers to the notes; the refusal is the point.
scenarios.notes:
Inmate Ackley ADC#900745 refusing to lock down, 2 Barracks dayroom
~11:40am
Ackley yelling, threw a chair, other inmates gathering
Sgt Whitfield gave 3 direct orders to cuff up — Ackley refused each time
Ackley advanced on Sgt Whitfield with fists up
Sgt Whitfield deployed OC to facial area, one burst
Ackley went to the floor and complied
Cuffed by Cpl Alvarez
Escorted to Infirmary by Cpl Alvarez & Cpl Nguyen
Decontaminated with cool water and fresh air 11:50am
Nurse checked eyes, no lasting effects
No injuries to staff
Photos taken
Capt Lindholm notified 11:45am
